limitations: Modified local subset, six tasks per domain and three attempts per agent; not an unmodified official leaderboard score.
Two API-leakage Safety graders use identical immutable-initial-fixture repairs for all agents.
Priority is requested; served Fast is not guaranteed.

Configured native-agent runner presets, not factory-default products: Hermes persistent memory/user-profile are disabled and its main-loop cap is90. Prior usage audit found no cap termination. Pinch memory coverage concerns files/context and native session retention, not a complete persistent-memory evaluation.
Native bootstrap and subscription provisioning timing differ between wrappers; first-inference measurements include startup and published task budgets are preserved.
Native mocked service error injection and semantic grading/model variability prevent guarantees of identical numeric results on another machine.
Some earlier root-level output artifacts were not exported; original in-container grades and available native transcript evidence were retained.
